semantics: per_cover: total = round_nearest(covers * coeff_per_cover / yield, round_step). per_portion: total = covers * coeff_per_portion (no rounding). fixed_batch: batches = ceil(covers / covers_per_batch); total = batches * batch_size.
rounding: round_nearest(x, step) rounds to the nearest multiple of step; exact .5 ties round up.
